description: Source code for AppDelegate.m, implementing application delegate, web view configuration, and delegate methods for a macOS application using WebKit, with custom handling for headless mode, browser contexts, and JavaScript dialogs.

classes.name: WebViewDialog
classes.description: Custom dialog class for handling JavaScript alert, confirm, and prompt dialogs within WKWebView.

classes.name: BrowserAppDelegate
classes.description: Main application delegate managing window creation, web view configurations, browser contexts, and delegate methods for WKWebView.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes the app delegate, processes command-line arguments, and sets up headless mode and inspector pipe if specified.

methods.name: awakeFromNib
methods.description: Enables Touch Bar customization if supported.

methods.name: proxyConfiguration:WithBypassList:
methods.description: Creates a proxy configuration dictionary based on provided proxy server string and bypass list.

methods.name: persistentDataStore
methods.description: Returns a singleton WKWebsiteDataStore configured with local storage directories and proxy settings.

methods.name: defaultConfiguration
methods.description: Returns a singleton WKWebViewConfiguration with preferences and process pool set for automation.

methods.name: applicationDidFinishLaunching:
methods.description: Sets up initial window or headless mode after app launch, creating the first web page.

methods.name: _updateNewWindowKeyEquivalents
methods.description: Sets keyboard shortcut for new window menu item.

methods.name: sessionConfiguration:
methods.description: Provides a WKWebViewConfiguration for a given session ID, matching browser context.

methods.name: createNewPage:withURL:
methods.description: Creates a new WKWebView for a session, either headless or headful based on mode.

methods.name: createHeadlessPage:withURL:
methods.description: Creates a headless WKWebView in an off-screen window.

methods.name: createHeadfulPage:withURL:
methods.description: Creates a visible WKWebView in a new window.

methods.name: createBrowserContext:WithBypassList:
methods.description: Creates a new browser context with optional proxy settings.

methods.name: deleteBrowserContext:
methods.description: Removes a browser context by session ID.
